release_evidence.remote_review_scope: GitHub source, manifest, freeze, release receipts and additive diff inspected; no claim of independent re-execution of all large archives in the reviewer environment.

scientific_bounds.supported: Bounded strict failure -> Halt -> eligible TEST_ONLY trusted serial authorized three-node new mission in seen Walk6 and one Turn45-transition history condition; six refused requests per eligible refusal arm, with zero incremental execution by the refusals themselves.
scientific_bounds.inconclusive_reason: Frozen world-+Y 60N push parent passes strict endpoint envelope; both push arms have NO_HALT_TRIGGER and supply no required additional failure-chain coverage.
scientific_bounds.qualification: 3/3 means three task nodes, not three independently sampled trials. Single seed-0 deterministic conditions do not establish statistical cross-state reliability.
scientific_bounds.halt: Small first-qualification last-1s mean-speed margins; no post-qualification sustained hold evidence.
scientific_bounds.production: TEST_ONLY trusted serial is not production authority, concurrency-safe atomicity, generalized recovery, or hardware safety.
